# cursor-sdk-bridge pin

Pinned Cursor SDK Bridge release used by Grok's sidecar packaging.

- Tag: see [`VERSION`](VERSION) (`v1.0.28`)
- Checksums: [`SHA256SUMS`](SHA256SUMS) (from the GitHub release)
- Contract: [`proto/sdk/v1/`](proto/sdk/v1/) — generated by Cursor, do not edit
- Fetch helper: [`../../crates/codegen/xai-grok-pager/scripts/fetch-cursor-sdk-bridge.sh`](../../crates/codegen/xai-grok-pager/scripts/fetch-cursor-sdk-bridge.sh)

Upstream: https://github.com/cursor/sdk-bridge

The standalone binaries are **not** vendored in git. Release/CI downloads the
archive for the host platform and ships `bin/cursor-sdk-bridge` next to `grok`.
